title: 第21章 不讲武德的天才第22章 本大王原来这么厉害的吗
content_zh:
“卧槽？”
这一剑以一个刁钻的角度袭来，完全看不清轨迹，纯小白只觉一股危险扑面而来，瞬间封堵了他的上路。
千钧一发之际，纯小白急中生智，往地下一蹲，整个人直接缩成一团，
那凌厉的剑锋刚好贴着他的头皮扫过，带起的剑气劲风刮的他脸颊生疼。
“你妹的，大意了！”
纯小白心有余悸的吐出一口气，“这个家伙果然有几分自傲的本钱。”
场外的弟子们看到这一幕，直接炸开了锅。
“赵师兄的剑法果然名不虚传！”
“是啊，直接给他吓趴下了！”
众人看到纯小白那狼狈的蹲地姿势，纷纷开始为赵无元激动地鼓掌叫好。
这让他山大王的面子往哪儿搁？
纯小白气得不行，一抬头，便看见赵无元手腕再转，一道剑光再次朝着他横挥而来。
他脚下猛地发力，一个“鹞子翻身”从地上弹起，手中长剑一横！
“锵！”
一声清脆的金铁交鸣，纯小白稳稳地挡住了赵无元的横刺。
抓住剑锋碰撞的这个缝隙，纯小白借力向后一闪，瞬间拉开一段距离。
他知道。
这个家伙高超的不是力量，而是赵长老所说……对剑的掌控！
一柄普普通通的长剑在他手中，剑尖吞吐不定，让人防不胜防。
也就他这种对刀法早已炉火纯青之人，才能招架的住，换做其他人，光是第一剑就得被直接扎成一个透心凉。

场外，顾长风站在那里背着手，看着场中的交锋，暗自点了点头。
刚才只是短短两剑，但他已然能看出纯小白的功底。
其反应速度、对危机的预判，都远超常人。
这可不是一招一式苦练就能练就出来的，而是需要经历真正生死磨练，才能刻入骨髓的本能反应。
这小子，到底是从哪里冒出来的？
赵无元见自己这般刁钻的一剑，竟然被这家伙轻松化解，脸上面子顿时有些挂不住了。
他决定不再给纯小白任何机会。
当即使出他的成名剑技——《碎星剑诀》！
他左脚猛地一踏地面，右手长剑剑身高速旋转，发出一阵尖锐的嗡鸣声，整个人化作一道残影，直奔纯小白。
纯小白却不避不闪，一双眼睛死死盯着他脚下的动作。
以他十五年的生死刀法经验，一眼就看出他这套剑法的根基在于下盘的步法走位！
就是现在！
纯小白目光一定，不退反进，双手猛地甩动剑身，长剑悬浮于头顶。
在剑锋接近他胸口一尺之时，他精准地抓到了那个转瞬即逝的破绽！
身体猛地向右一侧，手腕发力，那悬在头顶的长剑，竟以一个不可思议的角度，竖斩而下！
赵无元察觉到那一道朴实无华的剑锋，竟如同庖丁解牛般，从自己繁复的剑芒缝隙中精准地竖劈而来。
瞳孔骤然一缩。
来不及犹豫，他只得右手猛地一抽，撤回剑身，横在头顶。
“锵！”
赵无元只觉得一股不可思议的巨力从剑身袭来，右臂一麻，瞬间失去知觉。

这股力道还未停歇，透体而入，直达胸腔，带着他的身体不由自主地向后横移而去。
“噗！”
待他停下动作，喉咙一甜，一口鲜血抑制不住地喷了出来。
“刀魂？！”
content_en:
"What the hell?"
The sword struck at a tricky angle, and the trajectory was completely unclear. Chun Xiaobai felt a wave of danger coming towards him, instantly blocking his path.
At the critical moment, Chun Xiaobai suddenly realized what he was doing and squatted down on the ground, shrinking into a ball.
The sharp sword edge just brushed against his scalp, and the strong wind of the sword energy caused pain to his cheeks.
"Your sister, you are careless!"
Chun Xiaobai breathed out with lingering fear, "This guy really has some pride."
The disciples outside the field exploded when they saw this scene.
"Senior Brother Zhao's swordsmanship is indeed well-deserved!"
"Yeah, he was scared to death!"
Seeing Chun Xiaobai's awkward squatting posture, everyone began to applaud Zhao Wuyuan excitedly.
Where does this put the face of his mountain king?
Chun Xiaobai was so angry that when he looked up, he saw Zhao Wuyuan's wrist turning again, and a sword light swung towards him again.
He exerted force under his feet, and bounced up from the ground with a "Kite Turn", and the long sword in his hand moved horizontally!
"Qiang!"
With a crisp sound of gold and iron, Chun Xiaobai steadily blocked Zhao Wuyuan's horizontal thrust.
Seizing the gap where the sword blades collided, Chun Xiaobai used his strength to dodge backwards and instantly distanced himself.
He knows.
What is superb about this guy is not his strength, but what Elder Zhao said... his control of the sword!
An ordinary long sword was in his hand, and the tip of the sword was hesitant, making it difficult for people to guard against it.
Only someone like him, who is already proficient in sword fighting skills, can withstand it. If it were anyone else, the first sword alone would be directly stabbed to the core.
Outside the court, Gu Changfeng stood there with his hands behind his back, watching the confrontation in the court, and nodded secretly.
It was just two short sword blows, but he could already see Chun Xiaobai's skills.
Its reaction speed and prediction of crisis are far beyond ordinary people.
This is not something that can be learned through hard practice, but an instinctive reaction that needs to be truly tempered in life and death before it can be engraved into the bone marrow.
Where did this kid come from?
Zhao Wuyuan suddenly lost his composure when he saw that such a tricky sword attack of his was easily resolved by this guy.
He decided not to give Chun Xiaobai any chance.
Immediately he showed off his famous sword skill - "Broken Star Sword Technique"!
He suddenly stepped on the ground with his left foot, and the long sword in his right hand spun at high speed, making a sharp buzzing sound. His whole body turned into an afterimage and headed straight for Chun Xiaobai.
However, Chun Xiaobai did not dodge, her eyes fixed on the movements at his feet.
With his fifteen years of experience in life and death swordsmanship, it can be seen at a glance that the foundation of his swordsmanship lies in the footwork of the lower body!
That's it now!
Chun Xiaobai's eyes were fixed, and he advanced instead of retreating. He violently swung the sword with both hands, and the long sword was suspended above his head.
When the sword edge came within a foot of his chest, he accurately caught the fleeting flaw!
He jerked his body to the right, exerted force on his wrist, and the long sword hanging above his head slashed down vertically at an incredible angle!
Zhao Wuyuan noticed that the simple and unpretentious sword blade struck accurately vertically from the gaps in his complicated sword light, just like a chef cutting off an ox.
The pupils suddenly shrank.
With no time to hesitate, he had no choice but to twitch his right hand sharply, withdraw the sword, and place it horizontally above his head.
"Qiang!"
Zhao Wuyuan felt an incredible force coming from the sword. His right arm went numb and he lost consciousness instantly.
This force had not yet stopped, penetrating into his body and reaching his chest, moving his body backwards and away involuntarily.
"Poof!"
When he stopped, his throat felt sweet, and a mouthful of blood spurted out uncontrollably.
"Sword Soul?!"
